017package org.apache.juneau.http.response;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.net.*;
023import java.util.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.http.*;

029/**
030 * Base class for concrete HTTP response objects in the {@code org.apache.juneau.http} stack.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * Holds a status line, an optional body, and an ordered list of headers. Provides classic-style
034 * fluent setters that mutate state and return {@code this}.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * Immutability is expressed with the "funnel + nested {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot" paradigm: every mutator routes
038 * through the single protected {@link #modify(Runnable)} choke-point, and each concrete leaf gets a nested
039 * {@code X.Unmodifiable} whose only behavioral override is a throwing {@code modify(...)}.  A leaf's
040 * {@link #unmodifiable()} factory returns a point-in-time snapshot of type {@code X.Unmodifiable}; any attempt to set a
041 * property on it throws an {@link UnsupportedOperationException}.
042 *
043 * <p>
044 * This is a self-typed (CRTP) root: a leaf declares <c>class Ok <jk>extends</jk> BasicHttpResponse&lt;Ok&gt;</c> and
045 * inherits leaf-typed fluent setters with no covariant overrides.
046 *
047 * <p>
048 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack
049 * ({@code org.apache.juneau.marshall.ng.*}).
050 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
051 * (and possibly earlier).
052 *
053 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
054 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
055 * </ul>
056 *
057 * @param <SELF> The self type for fluent setters.
058 * @since 9.2.1
059 */
060@SuppressWarnings({
061   "java:S119" // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
062})
063public abstract class BasicHttpResponse<SELF extends BasicHttpResponse<SELF>> implements HttpResponseMessage {
064
065   private HttpStatusLine statusLine;
066   private HttpHeaderList headers;
067   private HttpBody body;
068   private Locale locale;
069
070   /**
071    * Constructor with no body.
072    *
073    * @param statusLine The status line. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
074    */
075   protected BasicHttpResponse(HttpStatusLine statusLine) {
076      // Reason phrase is documented-nullable; StringBody.of asserts non-null, so guard against a valid status line
077      // that carries a null reason phrase (would otherwise NPE on a legitimate input).
078      this(statusLine, l(),
079         statusLine != null && statusLine.getReasonPhrase() != null ? StringBody.of(statusLine.getReasonPhrase()) : null);
080   }
081
082   /**
083    * Constructor with a body.
084    *
085    * @param statusLine The status line. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
086    * @param body The response body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
087    */
088   protected BasicHttpResponse(HttpStatusLine statusLine, HttpBody body) {
089      this(statusLine, l(), body);
090   }
091
092   /**
093    * Constructor with a string body (UTF-8, {@code text/plain}).
094    *
095    * @param statusLine The status line. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
096    * @param body The response body as a plain-text string. May be <jk>null</jk>.
097    */
098   protected BasicHttpResponse(HttpStatusLine statusLine, String body) {
099      this(statusLine, l(), body != null ? StringBody.of(body) : null);
100   }
101
102   /**
103    * Constructor with headers and an optional body.
104    *
105    * @param statusLine The status line. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
106    * @param headers The response headers. Can be <jk>null</jk> (treated as an empty list).
107    * @param body The response body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
108    */
109   protected BasicHttpResponse(HttpStatusLine statusLine, List<HttpHeader> headers, HttpBody body) {
110      this.statusLine = assertArgNotNull("statusLine", statusLine);
111      this.headers = HttpHeaderList.of(headers);
112      this.body = body;
113   }
114
115   /**
116    * Copy constructor.
117    *
118    * @param copyFrom The instance to copy. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
119    */
120   protected BasicHttpResponse(BasicHttpResponse<?> copyFrom) {
121      assertArgNotNull("copyFrom", copyFrom);
122      this.statusLine = copyFrom.statusLine;
123      this.headers = copyFrom.headers.copy();
124      this.body = copyFrom.body;
125      this.locale = copyFrom.locale;
126   }
127
128   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
129   // Read accessors
130   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
131
132   @Override /* HttpResponseMessage */
133   public HttpStatusLine getStatusLine() {
134      return statusLine;
135   }
136
137   @Override /* HttpResponseMessage */
138   public List<HttpHeader> getHeaders() {
139      return u(headers);
140   }
141
142   @Override /* HttpResponseMessage */
143   public HttpBody getBody() {
144      return body;
145   }
146
147   /**
148    * Returns the HTTP status code from the status line.
149    *
150    * @return The status code.
151    */
152   public int getStatusCode() {
153      return statusLine.getStatusCode();
154   }
155
156   /**
157    * Returns the locale associated with this response, if any.
158    *
159    * @return The locale, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
160    */
161   public Locale getLocale() {
162      return locale;
163   }
164
165   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
166   // Fluent setters (mutate this instance)
167   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
168
169   /**
170    * Sets the status line.
171    *
172    * @param value New status line. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
173    * @return This object.
174    */
175   public SELF setStatusLine(HttpStatusLine value) {
176      return modify(() -> statusLine = assertArgNotNull("value", value));
177   }
178
179   /**
180    * Sets the status code, preserving the existing protocol version and reason phrase.
181    *
182    * @param value New status code.
183    * @return This object.
184    */
185   public SELF setStatusCode(int value) {
186      return modify(() -> statusLine = HttpStatusLineBean.of(statusLine.getProtocolVersion(), value, statusLine.getReasonPhrase()));
187   }
188
189   /**
190    * Sets the reason phrase, preserving the existing protocol version and status code.
191    *
192    * @param value New reason phrase. May be <jk>null</jk>.
193    * @return This object.
194    */
195   public SELF setReasonPhrase(String value) {
196      return modify(() -> statusLine = HttpStatusLineBean.of(statusLine.getProtocolVersion(), statusLine.getStatusCode(), value));
197   }
198
199   /**
200    * Sets the protocol version, preserving the existing status code and reason phrase.
201    *
202    * @param value New protocol version. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
203    * @return This object.
204    */
205   public SELF setProtocolVersion(HttpProtocolVersion value) {
206      return modify(() -> {
207         assertArgNotNull("value", value);
208         statusLine = HttpStatusLineBean.of(value, statusLine.getStatusCode(), statusLine.getReasonPhrase());
209      });
210   }
211
212   /**
213    * Replaces all headers with the given list.
214    *
215    * @param values New headers. {@code null} is treated as an empty list.
216    * @return This object.
217    */
218   public SELF setHeaders(List<HttpHeader> values) {
219      return modify(() -> {
220         headers.clear();
221         if (values != null)
222            headers.append(values);
223      });
224   }
225
226   /**
227    * Replaces all headers with the given array.
228    *
229    * @param values New headers. {@code null} is treated as an empty array.
230    * @return This object.
231    */
232   public SELF setHeaders(HttpHeader...values) {
233      return modify(() -> {
234         headers.clear();
235         if (values != null)
236            headers.append(values);
237      });
238   }
239
240   /**
241    * Sets a single header, replacing any existing header with the same name.
242    *
243    * @param value The header to set. {@code null} is ignored.
244    * @return This object.
245    */
246   public SELF setHeader(HttpHeader value) {
247      return modify(() -> headers.set(value));
248   }
249
250   /**
251    * Sets a single header, replacing any existing header with the same name.
252    *
253    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
254    * @param value Header value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
255    * @return This object.
256    */
257   public SELF setHeader(String name, String value) {
258      return modify(() -> headers.set(name, value));
259   }
260
261   /**
262    * Appends a header to the end of the header list.
263    *
264    * @param value The header to add. {@code null} is ignored.
265    * @return This object.
266    */
267   public SELF addHeader(HttpHeader value) {
268      return modify(() -> headers.append(value));
269   }
270
271   /**
272    * Appends a header to the end of the header list.
273    *
274    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
275    * @param value Header value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
276    * @return This object.
277    */
278   public SELF addHeader(String name, String value) {
279      return modify(() -> headers.append(name, value));
280   }
281
282   /**
283    * Sets the response body.
284    *
285    * @param value New body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
286    * @return This object.
287    */
288   public SELF setBody(HttpBody value) {
289      return modify(() -> body = value);
290   }
291
292   /**
293    * Sets the response body to a plain-text string body (UTF-8, {@code text/plain}).
294    *
295    * @param value Body text. May be <jk>null</jk>.
296    * @return This object.
297    */
298   public SELF setContent(String value) {
299      return setBody(value != null ? StringBody.of(value) : null);
300   }
301
302   /**
303    * Sets the response body.
304    *
305    * @param value New body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
306    * @return This object.
307    */
308   public SELF setContent(HttpBody value) {
309      return setBody(value);
310   }
311
312   /**
313    * Sets the locale associated with this response.
314    *
315    * @param value New locale. May be <jk>null</jk>.
316    * @return This object.
317    */
318   public SELF setLocale(Locale value) {
319      return modify(() -> locale = value);
320   }
321
322   /**
323    * Sets the value of the {@code Location} header.
324    *
325    * @param value The new location value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
326    * @return This object.
327    */
328   public SELF setLocation(String value) {
329      return setHeader(Location.NAME, value);
330   }
331
332   /**
333    * Sets the value of the {@code Location} header.
334    *
335    * @param value The new location value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
336    * @return This object.
337    */
338   public SELF setLocation(URI value) {
339      return setHeader(Location.NAME, value != null ? value.toString() : null);
340   }
341
342   /**
343    * Returns whether this instance is an unmodifiable snapshot.
344    *
345    * @return <jk>true</jk> if this bean is an {@link UnmodifiableBean} snapshot.
346    */
347   public boolean isUnmodifiable() {
348      return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean;
349   }
350
351   /**
352    * Returns an unmodifiable snapshot of this bean.
353    *
354    * <p>
355    * The returned instance is a point-in-time copy of the leaf's nested {@code Unmodifiable} type; any attempt to set a
356    * property on it throws an {@link UnsupportedOperationException}.  This method is idempotent: if this bean is already
357    * unmodifiable it returns itself rather than taking another snapshot.  The receiver is left unchanged (and still
358    * modifiable unless it was already unmodifiable).
359    *
360    * @return An unmodifiable snapshot of this bean, or this bean if it is already unmodifiable.
361    */
362   public abstract SELF unmodifiable();
363
364   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
365   // Fluent "with" helpers (mutate this instance and return the leaf type)
366   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
367
368   /**
369    * Sets the body on this response.
370    *
371    * @param value The new body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
372    * @return This object.
373    */
374   public SELF withBody(HttpBody value) {
375      return modify(() -> body = value);
376   }
377
378   /**
379    * Sets the body on this response as a plain-text string.
380    *
381    * @param value The new body as a plain-text string. May be <jk>null</jk>.
382    * @return This object.
383    */
384   public SELF withBody(String value) {
385      return withBody(value != null ? StringBody.of(value) : null);
386   }
387
388   /**
389    * Appends a header to this response.
390    *
391    * @param header The header to add. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
392    * @return This object.
393    */
394   public SELF withHeader(HttpHeader header) {
395      return modify(() -> headers.append(assertArgNotNull("header", header)));
396   }
397
398   /**
399    * Appends a header to this response.
400    *
401    * @param name The header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
402    * @param value The header value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
403    * @return This object.
404    */
405   public SELF withHeader(String name, String value) {
406      return withHeader(HttpHeaderBean.of(name, value));
407   }
408
409   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
410   // Immutability paradigm plumbing
411   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
412
413   /**
414    * Returns this object cast to the self type.
415    *
416    * @return This object.
417    */
418   @SuppressWarnings({
419      "unchecked" // CRTP self-type cast is safe: SELF is bound to the concrete leaf type.
420   })
421   protected final SELF self() {
422      return (SELF) this;
423   }
424
425   /**
426    * Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.
427    *
428    * <p>
429    * Every fluent setter routes through this method.  The nested {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot overrides only this
430    * method to throw, which freezes the entire mutation surface with a single override.
431    *
432    * @param mutation The state change to apply.
433    * @return This object.
434    */
435   protected SELF modify(Runnable mutation) {
436      mutation.run();
437      return self();
438   }
439
440   /**
441    * Deep-freeze hook invoked from the nested {@code Unmodifiable} constructor after the snapshot copy completes.
442    *
443    * <p>
444    * The mutable sub-beans are frozen here by <b>direct field assignment</b> (never via a setter, which would route
445    * through the throwing {@link #modify(Runnable)} and blow up during construction).  A leaf that adds its own mutable
446    * sub-bean overrides this method (calling {@code super.freeze()} first).
447    */
448   protected void freeze() {
449      headers = headers.unmodifiable();   // DIRECT field write — snapshot the copied HttpHeaderList.
450   }
451
452   @Override /* Object */
453   public boolean equals(Object o) {
454      return o instanceof BasicHttpResponse<?> other && eq(this, other, (x, y) ->
455         eq(x.statusLine, y.statusLine) && eq(x.headers, y.headers) && eq(x.body, y.body));
456   }
457
458   @Override /* Object */
459   public int hashCode() {
460      return h(statusLine, headers, body);
461   }
462
463   @Override /* Object */
464   public String toString() {
465      return statusLine.toString();
466   }
467}
